title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，依据频道主题与证据信号筛选候选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Discovery of Selective Small-Molecule Ligands of SV2C by AI-Enhanced Virtual Screening and Experimental Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2C (SV2C) is a vesicular protein enriched in dopaminergic neurons of the basal ganglia that modulates dopamine storage and release, and its disruption is implicated in Parkinson's disease (PD). Despite strong genetic and pathological links to PD, there are no selective small-molecule probes for SV2C. Here, we describe an AI-enhanced virtual screening (VS) and experimental campaign that identified multiple novel chemotypes with low-micromolar affinity and marked selectivity for SV2C over SV2A and SV2B, starting from a large, general-purpose commercial library. Because no full-length high-resolution SV2C structure was available, we built a homology model using SV2A cryo-EM structures as templates and characterized its conformational landscape by molecular dynamics (MD) and Gaussian accelerated MD (GaMD) simulations in apo form and in complex with known SV2 ligands (plosaracetam, levetiracetam, brivaracetam, and padsevonil). A convolutional neural network-based scoring function (CNN_VS), retrospectively validated on a manually curated 39-ligand SV2A benchmark (r = 0.72 vs experimental pIC50), was then applied in a multi-stage funnel to 5.96 million Mcule in-stock compounds, which were sequentially filtered to 3.19 million CNS-relevant molecules before docking and rescoring. From 94 VS-prioritized candidates, 71 compounds were experimentally profiled in an orthogonal primary assay cascade combining a thermal shift assay (TSA) with a [3H]-padsevonil scintillation proximity assay (SPA), followed by Ki determination and isoform selectivity profiling for key hits. This campaign yielded 22 active molecules (31% hit rate) that naturally segregated into two categories: compounds that showed primary site competition, and compounds that did not show primary site competition with [3H]-padsevonil. A subset of competitor compounds also showed thermostabilization activity. Among these, compounds 36 and 56 emerged as particularly attractive leads, with Ki values of 24.6 uM and 3.25 uM at SV2C, respectively, and greater than 10-fold selectivity versus SV2A; compound 56 also maintained approximately 12-fold selectivity relative to SV2B. A complementary subset of SV2C-selective hits behaved as padsevonil-site competitors, providing a lead set that will serve as a template for functional characterization and future drug development for conditions that affect dopaminergic signaling. Docking analysis suggests a common binding mode anchored by conserved tryptophan residues in the SV2 pocket, a prediction independently confirmed by an unpublished SV2A-plosaracetam cryo-EM structure showing 0.76 Angstrom binding-site C-alpha RMSD relative to the SV2C model and complete conservation of the tryptophan cage. Subtle differences in the luminal domain and transmembrane region point to the structural determinants underlying isoform selectivity. Collectively, these results demonstrate that an AI-driven VS pipeline, tightly integrated with medium-throughput biophysical assays, can deliver selective SV2C binders from a general chemical library on a structurally under-characterized membrane target. The identified hits provide multiple starting points for hit-to-lead optimization and tools for probing SV2C biology and its role in PD.
items.summary_zh: 研究以SV2A冷冻电镜结构为模板构建SV2C同源模型，结合MD、GaMD、卷积神经网络评分和虚拟筛选，从596万化合物中筛得候选，并对71个化合物进行热稳定性、放射性配体竞争、Ki和亚型选择性实验。共发现22个活性分子，其中化合物56对SV2C的Ki为3.25 μM，且相对SV2A、SV2B均表现出十倍以上选择性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是AI筛选与正交生物物理实验紧密结合的膜蛋白先导发现案例，为结构信息有限靶点提供了可检验的发现路线。当前命中物仍以低微摩尔活性为主，结合模式依赖同源模型，后续仍需功能实验、结构验证和优化研究。
items.author_line: Brueckner, A. C., Martin, M. F., Khuttan, S. 等 12 人
items.abstract_zh: 突触囊泡糖蛋白2C（SV2C）是一种在基底神经节多巴胺能神经元中富集的囊泡蛋白，调节多巴胺储存与释放，其破坏与帕金森病（PD）有关。尽管与PD存在强遗传和病理联系，目前尚无针对SV2C的选择性小分子探针。本文描述了一项AI增强的虚拟筛选（VS）与实验活动：从大型通用商业库出发，鉴定出多种对SV2C具有低微摩尔亲和力、并相对SV2A和SV2B具有显著选择性的新化学型。由于没有全长高分辨率SV2C结构可用，我们以SV2A冷冻电镜结构为模板构建同源模型，并通过分子动力学（MD）和高斯加速MD（GaMD）模拟，在apo形式以及与已知SV2配体（plosaracetam、levetiracetam、brivaracetam和padsevonil）的复合物中表征其构象景观。随后，一种基于卷积神经网络的评分函数（CNN_VS）——在人工整理的39配体SV2A基准上经回顾验证（相对实验pIC50，r = 0.72）——以多阶段漏斗应用于596万个Mcule现货化合物，这些化合物在对接与重打分前被依次过滤至319万个中枢神经系统相关分子。从94个VS优先候选中，71个化合物在正交的一级测定级联中进行了实验表征，该级联结合热位移测定（TSA）与[3H]-padsevonil闪烁邻近测定（SPA），随后对关键命中进行Ki测定和亚型选择性分析。此次活动得到22个活性分子（命中率31%），它们自然分为两类：显示与[3H]-padsevonil主位点竞争的化合物，以及不显示主位点竞争的化合物。一部分竞争化合物还表现出热稳定化活性。其中，化合物36和56成为特别有吸引力的先导物，在SV2C上的Ki值分别为24.6 uM和3.25 uM，相对SV2A具有大于10倍的选择性；化合物56相对SV2B也保持了约12倍选择性。一组互补的SV2C选择性命中表现为padsevonil位点竞争剂，提供了一套将作为功能表征以及面向影响多巴胺能信号的疾病的未来药物开发模板的先导集合。对接分析提示一种由SV2口袋中保守色氨酸残基锚定的共同结合模式，该预测被一项未发表的SV2A–plosaracetam冷冻电镜结构独立证实：相对SV2C模型，结合位点C-alpha RMSD为0.76 Å，且色氨酸笼完全保守。腔域和跨膜区的细微差异指向了亚型选择性背后的结构决定因素。综合来看，这些结果表明，与中通量生物物理测定紧密整合的AI驱动VS流程，能够从通用化学库中、针对结构表征不足的膜靶点交付选择性SV2C结合剂。所鉴定的命中为hit-to-lead优化提供了多个起点，并可作为探究SV2C生物学及其在PD中作用的工具。

items.title: Evidence for significant multi-Li+ clustering in common lithium-ion battery electrolytes
items.abstract_or_text: Lithium-ion battery (LIB) electrolytes have been empirically optimized to maximize battery lifetime and charge rate, but a detailed understanding of how their atomic-scale structure controls their electrochemical behaviors remains lacking. Here, we combine machine-learning-enabled atomistic simulations, nuclear magnetic resonance measurements, electrochemical data, and quantum-chemical calculations to reveal previously unstudied multi-Li+ complexes without anions that are uniquely facile for reduction. This surprising insight explains the success of empirically-chosen ethylene carbonate (EC) containing solvent mixtures and provides a foundation for the rational design of improved electrolytes. Furthermore, our machine learning force field (MLFF) based LIB electrolyte simulations accurately reproduce a wide range of condensed phase experiments, despite being parameterized only to quantum chemical gas phase cluster calculations, and hence provide a compelling demonstration that MLFF models developed from first principles can robustly represent a complex chemical system to atomic resolution.
items.summary_zh: 研究将机器学习原子级模拟、核磁共振、电化学测量和量子化学计算结合起来，提出常见锂离子电池电解液中存在无阴离子参与的多Li+团簇，并认为这类易被还原的结构有助于解释含碳酸乙烯酯混合溶剂的经验优势。其机器学习力场仅由气相团簇量子化学数据参数化，却能再现多种凝聚相实验现象。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把数据驱动势能面与谱学、电化学证据并置，直接服务于电解液分子设计，也展示了第一性原理机器学习力场在复杂液相体系中的潜力。多Li+团簇与实际电池寿命和倍率性能之间的因果联系，以及结论对配方范围的适用性，仍需更广泛验证。
items.author_line: James M. Stevenson, Garvit Agarwal, Sibali Debnath 等 19 人
items.abstract_zh: 锂离子电池（LIB）电解液已通过经验优化以最大化电池寿命和充电速率，但其原子尺度结构如何控制电化学行为仍缺乏细致理解。本文将机器学习赋能的原子模拟、核磁共振测量、电化学数据与量子化学计算相结合，揭示了此前未研究的、不含阴离子且还原异常容易的多 Li+ 配合物。这一出人意料的认识解释了经验选择的含碳酸乙烯酯（EC）溶剂混合物为何成功，并为改进电解液的理性设计提供了基础。此外，我们基于机器学习力场（MLFF）的 LIB 电解液模拟准确再现了广泛的凝聚相实验，尽管其参数化仅基于量子化学气相簇计算，从而有力表明：从第一性原理发展的 MLFF 模型能够以原子分辨率稳健表征复杂化学体系。

items.title: TRACER navigates rearrangement-driven sesterterpene chemical space via multimodal enzyme-product representation learning
items.abstract_or_text: Skeletal rearrangement drives the immense structural complexity of terpene, yet predicting it remains a formidable challenge due to sequence-function decoupling in terpene synthases. Here, we established TRACER (terpene rearrangement annotation via co-attentive enzyme-product representation), a multimodal framework mapping the latent associations between sequence-derived enzyme representations and product chemotypes. Retrospective validation proved TRACER's exceptional precision in predicting compound classes and discriminating skeletal rearrangement (SR) from non-skeletal rearrangement (NSR) pathways. TRACER-guided genome mining characterized two bifunctional synthases, FsPS and AcPS, uncovering four unprecedented carbon skeletons. Density functional theory calculations deciphered these cyclization cascades, pinpointing a critical 5/6/11 tricyclic intermediate as the key branching node for scaffold diversification. Mutagenesis and molecular dynamics simulations suggested that E305 in FsPS enables rearrangement by maintaining active-site water exclusion, whereas its alanine mutation causes premature carbocation quenching. Collectively, this work establishes a predictive paradigm for the rational discovery and mechanistic elucidation of complex terpene architectures.
items.summary_zh: TRACER将酶序列表征与萜类产物化学型共同学习，用于预测倍半萜合酶的骨架重排。模型指导基因组挖掘发现两种双功能合酶及四种此前未报道的碳骨架，并以密度泛函计算、定点突变和分子动力学分析环化级联及关键位点E305的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把表征学习用于天然产物骨架发现，并由新产物和机制实验形成较强支撑，可加速复杂萜类化学空间的探索。现有结论聚焦倍半萜体系，模型向其他萜类家族和更大序列空间推广时的性能仍待检验。
items.author_line: Xing, C., Lv, K., Zhang, W. 等 17 人
items.abstract_zh: 骨架重排驱动了萜类巨大的结构复杂性，但由于萜烯合酶中的序列–功能解耦，预测重排仍是严峻挑战。本文建立了 TRACER（terpene rearrangement annotation via co-attentive enzyme-product representation，基于共注意力酶–产物表征的萜类重排注释），这是一个多模态框架，用于映射序列来源的酶表征与产物化学型之间的潜在关联。回顾性验证表明，TRACER 在预测化合物类别以及区分骨架重排（SR）与非骨架重排（NSR）路径方面具有出色精度。在 TRACER 引导的基因组挖掘中，表征了两种双功能合酶 FsPS 和 AcPS，发现了四种前所未有的碳骨架。密度泛函理论计算解析了这些环化级联，确定一个关键的 5/6/11 三环中间体为骨架多样化的关键分支节点。诱变和分子动力学模拟表明，FsPS 中的 E305 通过维持活性位点排水使重排得以发生，而其丙氨酸突变会导致碳正离子过早猝灭。总体而言，本工作为复杂萜类结构的理性发现与机制阐明建立了一种预测范式。

items.title: Assessing Codon Language Models for Context-Aware Codon Optimization in Nucleic Acid-Based Medicines
items.abstract_or_text: Codon optimization uses synonymous sequence changes to improve the expression and therapeutic performance of nucleic acid-based medicines. Masked language models (MLMs) have recently been proposed as alternatives to traditional, frequency-based codon optimization approaches, yet whether they offer a meaningful advantage over such simpler methods remains unclear. Here we benchmark three prominent MLMs --- CaLM, EnCodon and CodonTransformer --- across backtranslation fidelity, sequence generation and nine molecular phenotype prediction tasks, and experimentally evaluate model-designed sequences using a secreted embryonic alkaline phosphatase (SEAP) reporter. The models differed markedly in amino-acid fidelity and generated distinct synonymous sequence variants. However, no single model performed best across all benchmark tasks and simple sequence features remained competitive in several settings. Our interpretability analysis revealed that the models integrate a large window of codon context for making predictions, as opposed to frequency-based approaches. Our in vitro data showed that MLM-designed variants outperformed conventional and commercial vendor-derived sequences in both transient and stably integrated expression, supporting the models' ability to capture translational context beyond codon frequency. Together, our results establish MLMs as effective and complementary tools for codon optimization and suggest that sampling across multiple models may improve the likelihood of identifying high-performing therapeutic sequences.
items.summary_zh: 研究系统比较CaLM、EnCodon和CodonTransformer三种密码子语言模型在回译、序列生成和九类分子表型预测任务上的表现，并用SEAP报告基因进行体外表达验证。模型设计的同义序列在瞬时表达和稳定整合条件下均优于传统方法及商业供应商序列。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把核酸药物密码子优化从基准比较推进到湿实验检验，并指出不同模型各有所长，支持多模型采样策略。实验主要采用单一报告体系，能否普遍改善治疗性转录本的表达、稳定性和安全性仍需扩大验证。
items.author_line: Toneyan, S., Scholz, K., De Donno, C. 等 7 人
items.abstract_zh: 密码子优化利用同义序列改变来改善基于核酸的药物的表达与治疗性能。掩码语言模型（MLM）最近被提出作为传统的、基于频率的密码子优化方法的替代，但它们是否相对这些更简单方法具有有意义的优势仍不清楚。本文在回译保真度、序列生成和九项分子表型预测任务上对三种突出的MLM——CaLM、EnCodon和CodonTransformer——进行基准测试，并使用分泌型胚胎碱性磷酸酶（SEAP）报告系统实验评估模型设计的序列。这些模型在氨基酸保真度上差异显著，并生成了不同的同义序列变体。然而，没有单一模型在所有基准任务上表现最佳，且简单序列特征在若干设定中仍具竞争力。我们的可解释性分析显示，与基于频率的方法不同，这些模型整合了较大窗口的密码子上下文来进行预测。我们的体外数据显示，MLM设计的变体在瞬时和稳定整合表达中均优于常规序列和商业供应商来源序列，支持这些模型有能力捕捉超越密码子频率的翻译上下文。综合来看，我们的结果确立了MLM作为密码子优化的有效且互补的工具，并表明跨多个模型采样可能提高鉴定高性能治疗序列的可能性。

items.title: Physically Grounded Generative Modeling of All-Atom Biomolecular Dynamics
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting the kinetic pathways of biomolecular systems at all-atom resolution is crucial for understanding protein function and drug efficacy, yet this task is hindered by the immense computational cost of conventional molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. While deep learning has revolutionized static structure prediction and equilibrium ensemble sampling, simulating the kinetics of conformational transitions remains a critical challenge. We introduce BioKinema, a physically grounded generative model that predicts continuous-time, all-atom biomolecular trajectories at a fraction of the cost of traditional simulations. In particular, BioKinema utilizes a spatial-temporal diffusion architecture motivated by the exponential decay of correlations characteristic of Langevin dynamics, and is explicitly trained to generate trajectories with the correct kinetics and thermodynamics. It employs a hierarchical forecasting-and-interpolation strategy to overcome the error accumulation that often plagues long-horizon generation. Through extensive validation, we demonstrate that BioKinema generates physically stable and dynamically accurate trajectories suitable for rigorous downstream analysis. For protein systems, it reproduces the equilibrium thermodynamics of the conformational ensemble and the underlying kinetics. For protein-ligand complexes, it successfully elucidates mechanisms such as ligand-driven conformational changes and allosteric interactions. Furthermore, BioKinema leverages enhanced sampling data to predict rare kinetic events, emerging as a powerful tool for estimating ligand unbinding pathways. Collectively, these results establish BioKinema as a computationally efficient complement to MD simulations that bridges the gap between static structure and dynamic function, enabling high-throughput exploration of the kinetic landscape for structural biology and drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: BioKinema采用受朗之万动力学相关性启发的时空扩散架构，生成连续时间、全原子生物分子轨迹，并以分级预测与插值降低长时程误差。作者报告其可重现蛋白构象集合的热力学与动力学，并用于蛋白—配体体系的变构过程和稀有解离事件分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 如果动力学准确性经得起更广泛测试，该方法可显著降低高通量结构生物学和药物发现中的轨迹采样成本。摘要未给出与传统MD的统一定量误差和外部体系表现，且结果依赖增强采样数据，应用时需审慎比较。
items.author_line: Feng, B., Zhang, J., Zhang, X. 等 8 人
items.abstract_zh: 以全原子分辨率预测生物分子体系的动力学路径对于理解蛋白质功能与药效至关重要，但该任务受制于传统分子动力学（MD）模拟的巨大计算代价。尽管深度学习已变革静态结构预测与平衡系综采样，模拟构象转变的动力学仍是一项关键挑战。我们提出 BioKinema，一种物理奠基的生成模型，能以传统模拟的一小部分代价预测连续时间、全原子生物分子轨迹。具体而言，BioKinema 采用受 Langevin 动力学特征性相关指数衰减启发的时空扩散架构，并经显式训练以生成具有正确动力学与热力学的轨迹。它采用分层预测–插值策略，以克服长时程生成中常见的误差累积。通过广泛验证，我们表明 BioKinema 生成物理稳定、动力学准确、适合严格下游分析的轨迹。对于蛋白质体系，它复现构象系综的平衡热力学及底层动力学。对于蛋白–配体复合物，它成功阐明配体驱动的构象变化与别构相互作用等机制。此外，BioKinema 利用增强采样数据预测稀有动力学事件，成为估计配体解离路径的有力工具。综合来看，这些结果确立 BioKinema 作为 MD 模拟的计算高效补充，弥合静态结构与动态功能之间的差距，使结构生物学与药物发现能够高通量探索动力学图景。

items.title: A contextualised protein language model reveals the functional syntax of bacterial evolution
items.abstract_or_text: Bacteria have evolved a vast diversity of functions and behaviours that are currently incompletely understood and poorly predicted from DNA sequence alone. To understand the syntax of bacterial evolution and discover genome-to-phenotype relationships, we curated over 1.3 million genomes spanning bacterial phylogenetic space, represented each as an ordered sequence of proteins, and used these sequences to train a transformer-based, contextualised protein language model, Bacformer. By pretraining on genome-wide evolutionary patterns, Bacformer captures the compositional and positional relationships of proteins and thereby provides a whole-genome framework for linking genomic organisation and content to measurable bacterial traits. We demonstrate the ability of Bacformer to accurately predict protein-protein interactions; uncover operon structure, which we validated experimentally; infer important phenotypic traits, including antimicrobial resistance, while revealing likely causal genes; and design template synthetic proteomes with desirable properties. Thus, Bacformer establishes a genomic foundation model that reveals the evolutionary rules governing bacterial gene organisation, function, and phenotype, opening a route to systematic whole-genome engineering.
items.summary_zh: Bacformer以超过130万细菌基因组中按顺序排列的蛋白序列训练上下文化蛋白语言模型，学习基因组范围的组成和位置关系。研究显示该模型可预测蛋白互作、推断操纵子和耐药等表型相关基因，并对操纵子预测进行实验验证，还生成了具有目标属性的合成蛋白组模板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将蛋白语言模型从单序列扩展到全基因组组织信息，为微生物功能预测和合成生物学设计提供了新表征。表型关联及因果基因推断仍可能受系统发育和数据分布影响，更多独立实验验证十分关键。
items.author_line: Wiatrak, M., Abelson, D. C., Mikhaylenko, R. 等 12 人
items.abstract_zh: 细菌已进化出极为多样的功能与行为，目前对其理解尚不完整，且仅从 DNA 序列难以良好预测。为理解细菌进化的句法并发现基因组到表型的关系，我们整理了跨越细菌系统发育空间的超过 130 万个基因组，将每个基因组表示为有序蛋白质序列，并用这些序列训练基于 Transformer 的情境化蛋白质语言模型 Bacformer。通过对全基因组进化模式进行预训练，Bacformer 捕捉蛋白质的组成与位置关系，从而提供将基因组组织与内容关联到可测细菌性状的全基因组框架。我们展示了 Bacformer 准确预测蛋白质–蛋白质相互作用的能力；揭示操纵子结构并经实验验证；推断包括抗微生物耐药性在内的重要表型性状，同时揭示可能的因果基因；以及设计具有所需性质的模板合成蛋白质组。因此，Bacformer 建立了一个基因组基础模型，揭示支配细菌基因组织、功能与表型的进化规则，为系统性全基因组工程开辟了路径。

items.title: LEN-Seek: Fast and scalable ligand binding-site similarity search in the latent space of an SE(3)-invariant graph VAE
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation: Ligand binding-site similarity search is a crucial step in drug discovery that reduces the conformational search space for docking and other downstream tasks by comparing a target protein against experimentally identified binding sites. Existing methods rely on either direct structural alignment or lossy compression of structural information, producing a trade-off between scalability and precision. Results: We propose LEN-Seek, a ligand binding-site search method based on a graph neural network (GNN)-driven variational autoencoder (VAE) that encodes the 3D structural and physicochemical context of a binding site into a probabilistic latent space, enabling similarity search within a low-dimensional vector space. A binding site is modeled as a graph of amino acid residues, with node features adopted from the protein language model, Ankh, and edges encoded as SE(3)-invariant (roto-translational invariant) geometric relationships, thereby avoiding expensive data augmentation or SE(3)-equivariant models. Compared to ProBiS, the purely geometric graph-clique based method, LEN-Seek successfully retrieves a substantial portion of similar binding sites with a roughly 3,400-fold lower per-comparison cost, demonstrating its potential as a scalable approach to template-based ligand binding-site search in large-scale protein structure databases.
items.summary_zh: LEN-Seek以SE(3)不变图变分自编码器编码蛋白配体结合位点的三维几何和理化环境，在低维潜在空间完成相似位点检索。相较基于图团匹配的ProBiS，作者报告其保留大量相似位点检索能力，同时将单次比较成本降低约3400倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 快速结合位点检索可为模板化虚拟筛选和大规模结构库分析节省计算资源，且方法将蛋白语言模型特征与几何表示结合。摘要未充分交代不同靶标类别上的召回和精度细节，也缺少前瞻性药物发现验证。
items.author_line: Yeo, K., Kim, D., Sim, J. 等 4 人
items.abstract_zh: 动机：配体结合位点相似性检索是药物发现中的关键步骤，通过将靶蛋白与实验鉴定的结合位点进行比较，可缩小对接及其他下游任务的构象搜索空间。现有方法或依赖直接结构比对，或对结构信息进行有损压缩，因而在可扩展性与精度之间存在权衡。结果：我们提出 LEN-Seek，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）驱动变分自编码器（VAE）的配体结合位点检索方法。该方法将结合位点的三维结构与理化环境编码到概率潜空间中，从而在低维向量空间中实现相似性检索。结合位点被建模为氨基酸残基图，节点特征取自蛋白质语言模型 Ankh，边则编码为 SE(3) 不变（旋转–平移不变）的几何关系，从而避免昂贵的数据增强或 SE(3) 等变模型。与纯几何图团方法 ProBiS 相比，LEN-Seek 能成功检索到相当一部分相似结合位点，而单次比较成本约低 3,400 倍，显示其作为大规模蛋白质结构数据库中基于模板的配体结合位点检索可扩展方案的潜力。

items.title: Agentic AI in Process Analytical Technology: LLM Assistants for Chemometric Workflows
items.abstract_or_text: Modern manufacturing in chemical and pharmaceutical industries increasingly depends on real-time analytical insight to maintain quality, safety, and flexibility. Yet, turning process measurements into actionable analyses still depends on scarce chemometric expertise and manual workflows. Herein, we adapt agentic AI to the process analytical technology (PAT) domain by developing PAT agents that combine large language models (LLMs) with validated open-source and commercial chemometric software, including RamanSPy, SpectroChemPy and PEAXACT, under a multi-agent orchestrator. We benchmark the agents on nine real-world Raman data-analytics tasks of varying complexity, across three user personas, and several LLM backbones. The PAT agents with frontier LLMs solve analytical tasks at 93–96% pass rate, while numerical claims are grounded in actual tool outputs, and are thus physically consistent and reliable. The agents translate individual user requests into adaptive analytical workflows, halt and request clarification on inconsistent inputs, and remain reviewable through structured logs of every tool call and state transition. These results establish PAT agents as transparent digital coworkers that expand access to advanced process analytics and support more adaptive, data-rich manufacturing, while expert chemometric oversight remains critical for industrial deployment.
items.summary_zh: 研究构建面向过程分析技术的LLM智能体，将RamanSPy、SpectroChemPy和PEAXACT等化学计量学软件接入多智能体编排系统。在九项真实拉曼数据分析任务、三类用户角色和多种模型的测试中，前沿模型的通过率为93%至96%，数值结论由工具输出生成，并保留工具调用与状态记录。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作展示了语言模型如何在受工具约束的条件下参与化学与制药制造分析，强调可审查的数值工作流。基准任务规模较小，工业现场的仪器漂移、异常样本、合规要求与长期可靠性尚未得到充分覆盖。
items.author_line: Jan G. Rittig, Luise F. Kaven, Philippe Schwaller
items.abstract_zh: 化学与制药工业的现代制造日益依赖实时分析洞察以维持质量、安全与灵活性。然而，将过程测量转化为可执行分析仍依赖稀缺的化学计量学专业知识和人工工作流。本文将智能体人工智能适配到过程分析技术（PAT）领域，开发了 PAT 智能体：在多智能体编排器下，将大语言模型（LLM）与经验证的开源及商业化学计量学软件（包括 RamanSPy、SpectroChemPy 和 PEAXACT）相结合。我们在九项复杂度各异的真实拉曼数据分析任务上、跨三种用户画像和若干 LLM 骨干，对智能体进行基准测试。配备前沿 LLM 的 PAT 智能体以 93–96% 的通过率完成分析任务，数值论断均基于实际工具输出，因而物理一致且可靠。智能体将单个用户请求转化为自适应分析工作流，在输入不一致时暂停并请求澄清，并通过每次工具调用与状态转换的结构化日志保持可审查。这些结果将 PAT 智能体确立为透明的数字同事，可扩大先进过程分析的可及性，并支持更自适应、数据丰富的制造；而专家化学计量学监督对工业部署仍至关重要。

items.title: SAMP V2: A novel stacking ensemble learning model for antimicrobial peptides identification based on augmented split amino acid composition with biochemical-sequence-order information
items.abstract_or_text: Antimicrobial resistance reduces the effectiveness of conventional antibiotics and has become a major global health threat, highlighting the need for new anti-infective agents. Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), a diverse class of innate immune effectors with broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity, are promising candidates for combating drug-resistant infections. Identifying AMPs by wet-lab experiments, however, remains costly and time-consuming, creating a strong demand for computational identification methods. Our recently developed method, SAMP, captures region-specific residue distributions based on proportionalized split amino acid composition. However, SAMP might ignore key biochemical information and sequence order information. Here we present SAMP V2, a stacking ensemble learning framework based on biochemical and sequence-order information augmented split amino acid composition (BIA-SAAC), which extends SAMP by integrating pseudo-amino acid composition features with biochemical and sequence-order information into split peptide regions. Specifically, each peptide is divided into N-terminal, middle, and C-terminal regions, and pseudo amino acid composition is calculated within each region. Benchmarking tests on six independent test datasets, SAMP V2 outperformed multiple state-of-the-art models, including AMPpred-MFA and iAMP-Attenpred, in terms of accuracy, MCC, G-measure and F1-score. Given its high and robust performance, SAMP V2 could significantly accelerate the discovery of next-generation antimicrobial therapeutics for addressing the global threat of multidrug-resistant pathogens.
items.summary_zh: SAMP V2将肽序列按N端、中段和C端拆分，融合伪氨基酸组成、理化性质和序列顺序信息，并以堆叠集成模型识别抗菌肽。作者在六个独立测试集上比较多种现有模型，报告该方法在准确率、MCC、G-measure和F1等指标上表现更优。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 抗菌肽优先级排序有望缩小后续合成和活性测试的候选范围，研究也采用多个独立测试集而非单一划分。证据仍主要来自计算基准，数据集同源性、任务定义和候选肽的实测抗菌活性将决定其实际发现价值。
items.author_line: Sun, M., Wang, J., Wan, S.
items.abstract_zh: 抗微生物耐药性降低了传统抗生素的有效性，并已成为重大全球健康威胁，凸显了对新抗感染药物的需求。抗菌肽（AMP）是一类具有广谱抗微生物活性的多样化先天免疫效应分子，是对抗耐药感染的有前景候选。然而，通过湿实验鉴定AMP仍然昂贵且耗时，从而产生了对计算鉴定方法的强烈需求。我们最近开发的方法SAMP基于比例化分割氨基酸组成捕捉区域特异性残基分布。然而，SAMP可能忽略关键的生化信息和序列顺序信息。本文介绍SAMP V2，这是一个基于生化和序列顺序信息增强的分割氨基酸组成（BIA-SAAC）的堆叠集成学习框架，通过将伪氨基酸组成特征与生化和序列顺序信息整合到分割肽区段中来扩展SAMP。具体而言，每条肽被划分为N端、中间和C端区域，并在每个区域内计算伪氨基酸组成。在六个独立测试数据集上的基准测试中，SAMP V2在准确率、MCC、G-measure和F1-score方面优于包括AMPpred-MFA和iAMP-Attenpred在内的多个最先进模型。鉴于其高且稳健的性能，SAMP V2可显著加速下一代抗微生物治疗药物的发现，以应对多重耐药病原体的全球威胁。

items.title: Advances in Machine Learning, Limitations, and Performance Insight of Commonly used Computation Chemistry Methods for Solvation Free Energy Estimation
items.abstract_or_text: The accurate calculation of Gibbs free energy is a cornerstone of modern computational chemistry, essential for predicting the spontaneity of chemical reactions and the stability of molecular systems. Solvation free energy change is a fundamental thermodynamic quantity that describes the free energy change associated with transferring a solute from the gas phase into a solvent. It is particularly useful for estimating reaction rates and pathways of organic reactions, most of which occur in the liquid phase, and has important applications in organic synthesis, biochemistry, and drug discovery. 1 Central and persistent challenges are the choice of implicit and explicit models, delicate balance between achieving high accuracy in quantum mechanical descriptions of electronic structure and performing the extensive configurational sampling required to capture entropic effects, continual evolving of foundational statistical mechanics methods such as Free Energy Perturbation (FEP) and Thermodynamic Integration (TI) to more sophisticated multiscale and hybrid approaches for higher computational efficiency. 2,3,4 This report provides an overview of the theoretical frameworks, implementations, and predictive accuracy of commonly used methods for calculating solvation free energy , assessing classical alchemical methods, quantum chemistry based methods, and hybrid QM/MM approaches, while also addressing practical considerations. Finally, we examine the potential transformative role of emerging methods such as machine learning, which are poised to accelerate these calculations, making rigorous, large-scale free energy simulations feasible and better balancing the cost-accuracy trade-off that has long constrained the field. 5,6
items.summary_zh: 该综述梳理溶剂化自由能计算中的经典炼金方法、量子化学方法和QM/MM混合策略，讨论隐式与显式溶剂模型、构象采样和计算精度之间的关系，并评估机器学习在加速大规模自由能计算中的潜在作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 溶剂化自由能是反应预测、合成、生物化学和药物设计的重要基础量，综述有助于比较不同计算路线的适用条件。其主要贡献是方法整合而非新的基准或实验数据，文中对机器学习方法的实际增益仍应结合原始研究逐项判断。
items.abstract_zh: 准确计算吉布斯自由能是现代计算化学的基石，对于预测化学反应自发性和分子体系稳定性至关重要。溶剂化自由能变化是一个基本热力学量，描述溶质从气相转入溶剂时的自由能变化。它对于估计大多数发生在液相的有机反应的反应速率与路径尤其有用，并在有机合成、生物化学和药物发现中具有重要应用。1 长期存在的核心挑战包括：隐式与显式模型的选择；在量子力学电子结构描述中达到高精度与为捕捉熵效应所需的广泛构型采样之间的微妙平衡；以及将自由能微扰（FEP）和热力学积分（TI）等基础统计力学方法持续发展为更复杂的多尺度与杂化方法，以提高计算效率。2,3,4 本报告概述了常用溶剂化自由能计算方法的理论框架、实现与预测精度，评估经典炼金术方法、基于量子化学的方法以及杂化 QM/MM 方法，并讨论实际考量。最后，我们审视机器学习等新兴方法可能发挥的变革性作用：它们有望加速这些计算，使严格的大规模自由能模拟成为可能，并更好地平衡长期制约该领域的成本–精度权衡。5,6

review.note: 本次选出10项；均为预印本。排序优先考虑与AI×化学的直接关联、方法新意、实验或多模态数据支撑及可复核性。
